title: Knit image2pdf IPC & Data Contract
description: Machine-readable schema and Tauri IPC / Rust crate contract for Knit image2pdf (v0.2.0). Derived directly from crates/knit-pdf/src/models.rs, src-tauri/src/lib.rs, and src/types/ipc.ts.

x-ipc-operations.summary: Scan image files or folders into PageDraft[] and folder-based BookmarkNode[].
x-ipc-operations.description: Read-only disk scan with natural sort and AVIF header-seek optimization. Shifts subfolder BookmarkNode target_page_index offsets across multiple inputs. Requires Tauri runtime (isTauriRuntime() === true) and non-empty paths. Use checkMissingFiles before export if user may have moved files after import.

paths.description: Absolute filesystem paths to image files or root folders.

isFolder.description: When true (or when path is a directory), recursively walks subdirectories in natural order and generates hierarchical BookmarkNode entries.

onEvent.description: Optional Tauri Channel<JobEvent> receiving scan progress and log messages.

errors.pattern: Chua chon anh hoac thu muc anh
errors.cause: Empty paths array passed to pdf_scan_images.
Folder root does not exist on disk.

x-ipc-operations.summary: Re-expand or collapse animated image PageDrafts and remap bookmarks when animated_policy changes after import.
x-ipc-operations.description: Converts GIF/WebP ImageFile drafts into per-frame AnimatedFrame drafts when animatedPolicy == unpack_all_frames, or collapses contiguous AnimatedFrame runs back into a single ImageFile draft when switching to first_frame_only or embed_rich_media, remapping BookmarkNode target_page_index values.

x-ipc-operations.summary: Render and disk-cache a JPEG grid thumbnail, returning the local cache file path.
x-ipc-operations.description: Preferred thumbnail command. Uses thumb_semaphore (2..4 permits) and double-checked atomic disk cache in app_cache_dir/image-thumbs/. Wrap returned path with convertFileSrc(path) for WebView rendering. Use renderPageDraftPreviewFile instead when rendering cropped/rotated/annotated drafts.

path.description: Absolute path to source image file.

returns.description: Absolute path to cached .jpg file on disk. Pass through convertFileSrc() in browser UI.

x-ipc-operations.summary: Legacy Base64 PNG thumbnail renderer (prefer renderImageThumbFile).
x-ipc-operations.description: Deprecated for grid virtualization because PNG encoding and Base64 IPC serialization bloat WebView heap. Use renderImageThumbFile + convertFileSrc instead.

returns.description: Raw Base64-encoded PNG bytes (no data: prefix).

x-ipc-operations.summary: Render a high-priority edited PageDraft preview JPEG and return its disk cache path.
x-ipc-operations.description: Runs under preview_semaphore (2 isolated permits) so zoom/editor previews never queue behind grid thumbnails. Applies EXIF transpose, rotation_deg, normalized CropRect, and AnnotationLayer onto a white RGB surface and caches JPEG quality 82 on disk.

maxSize.description: Max pixel dimension; 0 preserves edited full dimensions.

returns.description: Absolute path to cached draft preview .jpg file on disk.

x-ipc-operations.summary: Return subset of source paths that no longer exist on disk before exporting.
x-ipc-operations.description: Read-only idempotent preflight check. Pass deduplicated PageDraft.source.path values before opening save dialogs or calling buildImage2Pdf. Returns empty array outside Tauri runtime.

paths.description: Unique source file paths to check via Path::exists().

returns.description: Missing paths from the input array (empty if all files exist).

x-ipc-operations.summary: Stream PageDraft[] and BookmarkNode[] into one or more PDF files on disk.
x-ipc-operations.description: Long-running cancellable background job. Processes images in bounded Rayon chunks (batch_size 4..24) and streams directly to disk via StreamingPdfWriter (256 KiB BufWriter + TempFilesGuard). Supports Fast (single output, passthrough), Balanced, and Safe modes, plus max_mb or max_pages_per_file splitting with bookmark remapping. Calls trim_process_heap() / malloc_trim(0) on completion or cancellation.

jobId.description: Caller-generated job ID registered for cancel_job.

onEvent.description: Optional Tauri Channel<JobEvent> throttled at ~10 Hz.

errors.cause: Draft with PageSource.kind == pdf_page passed into raster image2pdf export.
cancel_job(jobId) triggered; TempFilesGuard removes all .tmp artifacts.

x-ipc-operations.summary: Signal CancellationToken for an active pdf_build_from_images job.
x-ipc-operations.description: Idempotent cooperative cancellation. Aborts between Rayon chunks or pages and triggers TempFilesGuard cleanup of uncommitted .tmp files.

x-ipc-operations.summary: Delete disk thumbnail caches and release OS heap via malloc_trim(0).
x-ipc-operations.description: Safe to call when clearing the workspace list. Removes image-thumbs cache files, resets PDF/EPUB/Typst caches, and trims process heap on Linux glibc.

PageSource.description: Discriminated union identifying the read-only backing file and frame/page index for a PageDraft.

path.description: Absolute path to static image or first-frame animated image.
Absolute path to GIF or animated WebP.
Reserved for PDF editor pages; not valid input for raster image2pdf export.

CropRect.description: Normalized crop rectangle in [0.0, 1.0] relative to EXIF-oriented image dimensions.

text.description: UTF-8 label rendered onto the edited image.

font_size_ratio.description: Text height ratio relative to post-crop/rotate image height.

stroke_width_ratio.description: Stroke width ratio relative to shortest image side.

PageDraft.description: Non-destructive page edit state referencing a read-only image on disk.

rotation_deg.description: Clockwise additional rotation in degrees. Any non-zero value disables lossless passthrough.

duration_ms.description: Optional PDF page /Dur duration in milliseconds for animated frames.

BookmarkNode.description: PDF Outline node targeting a 0-based page index.

target_page_index.description: 0-based page index (clamped to page count - 1 when written).

PageBackground.description: Fill color behind fitted images on fixed paper sizes (FitA4 / FitLetter).

PageLayoutPolicy.description: PDF page dimensions clamped to ISO PDF bounds [3.0, 14400.0] pt.

margin_pt.description: Page margin in PDF points (1 mm = 72 / 25.4 pt). A4 = 595.28 x 841.89 pt.
Page margin in PDF points. Letter = 612.0 x 792.0 pt.

x-enumDescriptions.first_frame_only: Imports only frame 0 of GIF/WebP animations.
x-enumDescriptions.unpack_all_frames: Expands each frame into an AnimatedFrame PageDraft with duration_ms mapped to PDF /Dur.
x-enumDescriptions.embed_rich_media: Embeds animated GIF files directly into the PDF via /RichMedia and /Screen annotations (falls back to frame 0 for static formats).

x-enumDescriptions.fast: Max throughput (4..8 workers, batch 24). Skips disk space check and split rules (always 1 output file). Header-only passthrough checks.
x-enumDescriptions.balanced: Default (2..4 workers, batch 4..8). Checks 1x disk space, supports max_mb / max_pages_per_file, header-level passthrough.
x-enumDescriptions.safe: Max safety (2..4 workers, batch 4). Checks 2x disk space, supports splitting, full pixel decode verification before passthrough.

output_path.description: Target .pdf path. Multi-part splits write _part01.pdf, _part02.pdf, etc.

lossless_passthrough.description: When true, unedited JPEG/RGB-Gray8-PNG bypass decode/re-encode.

max_mb.description: Split output PDFs when next page would exceed max_mb MiB. Ignored when export_mode is fast.

max_pages_per_file.description: Split output PDFs after N pages. Ignored when export_mode is fast.

JobEvent.description: Tagged stream payload emitted over Tauri Channel<JobEvent>.
